claims: Jesus of Nazareth lived c. 6–4 BC – AD 30–33.
Jesus of Nazareth was a 1st-century Jewish teacher and preacher.
Jesus of Nazareth is the central figure of Christianity.
Scholars recognize Jesus of Nazareth as a historical figure.
Jesus of Nazareth was crucified in Judea under Pontius Pilate.
Christians believe Jesus is the Son of God.
Christians believe Jesus was resurrected to offer salvation.
Jesus was born to the Virgin Mary.
Jesus began his ministry around AD 26.
Jesus taught about the kingdom of God.
Jesus performed miracles.
Jesus gathered disciples.
Christians believe Jesus died for the sins of humanity.
Christians believe Jesus was resurrected on the third day.
Christians believe Jesus ascended to heaven.
Jesus' birth is celebrated at Christmas.
Jesus' crucifixion is associated with Good Friday.
Jesus' resurrection is associated with Easter.
Jesus is known as Jesus Christ.
Jesus is known as Jesus of Nazareth.
Jesus is known as Savior.
Jesus is known as Son of God.
Jesus is known as Lord.
Jesus is known as Lamb of God.
Jesus is known as the Messiah.
Jesus' birth occurred c. 6-4 BC in the Roman province of Judaea, according to Wikipedia and the YouTube video "The Historical Jesus (Full Series)".
Nearly all modern scholars agree that Jesus was a historical figure, according to the Bible Project and the Wikipedia article on Jesus's existence.
Jesus' life is documented in the Gospels, according to the Bible Project and the Wikipedia article on Jesus's existence.
Jesus was active in Galilee and Judea during a time of Roman rule.
